hooks.command:
cmd=""
if [ -f package.json ] && grep -q '"lint"[[:space:]]*:' package.json; then cmd="npm run lint"
elif [ -f Makefile ] && grep -qE '^lint:' Makefile; then cmd="make lint"
elif [ -f pyproject.toml ] && command -v ruff >/dev/null 2>&1; then cmd="ruff check ."
elif [ -f setup.cfg ] && command -v flake8 >/dev/null 2>&1; then cmd="flake8 ."
elif [ -f .golangci.yml ] && command -v golangci-lint >/dev/null 2>&1; then cmd="golangci-lint run"
fi
if [ -z "$cmd" ]; then echo "No linter is configured for this project yet (CLAUDE.md says the tech stack hasn't been decided) - commit allowed without lint checks. Once a language/tooling is chosen, add a lint script/config and this hook will start enforcing it automatically." >&2; exit 0; fi
echo "Running lint check: $cmd" >&2
if ! eval "$cmd"; then echo "Lint failed - fix the issues above before committing." >&2; exit 2; fi
exit 0
